// Original single-player renderer, adapted only at the multiplayer state boundary.
// Generated by tools/extract-original.mjs; the artwork and draw routines are retained.
export function createRenderer(canvas) {
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'), SHEET=new Image();SHEET.src='/atlas.png';
let spritesReady=false;SHEET.onload=()=>{spritesReady=true;};
const T=32,MAP_W=100,MAP_H=80,TILE_FLOOR=0,TILE_WALL=1,TILE_DOOR=2;
const CD_Q=240,CD_W=900,CD_E=600,CD_R=2700,CD_POTION=180;
const MAGE_CD_Q=240,MAGE_CD_W=360,MAGE_CD_E=900,MAGE_CD_R=2700;
const SPIN_DUR=72,SPIN_RANGE=70,AURA_DUR=420,DASHCUT_DUR=18,MAX_POTIONS=3;
let CW=canvas.width,CH=canvas.height,frameCount=0,gameTime=0,shake=0,flashRed=0;
let tilemap=[],mapRooms=[],visitedRooms=new Set(),currentRoomIdx=-1;
let player,allPlayers=[],enemies=[],items=[],scenery=[],projectiles=[],boss=null;
let particles=[],aoeRings=[],aiming=null,moveTarget=null;
let camera={x:0,y:0},doorInfo={doorY:54,doorXMin:48,doorXMax:51},doorOpenAnim=60;
let bossSpawned=false,enemyTotal=0,keeperDefeated=false,arenaSealed=false,doorPromptTimer=0;
const fxSeen=new Set(),hpSeen=new Map(),hitFlashes=new Map();let particleAccumulator=0,previous=null;
/* ORIGINAL_SPRITES */
/* ORIGINAL_PARTICLES */
/* ORIGINAL_DRAWING */
function drawTeamLabel(p){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=p.team==='red'?'#ff7777':'#77bbff';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x,p.y+12,18,7,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.font='bold 11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle=ctx.strokeStyle;ctx.fillText(p.name,p.x,p.y-52);ctx.restore();}
function adaptPlayer(p){return {...p,cls:p.cls==='warrior'?'knight':'mage',w:14,h:16,anim:frameCount*(p.moving?0.2:0.08),hitR:11,hpCap:6,hasKey:keeperDefeated,cdQ:(p.cd?.q||0)*60,cdW:(p.cd?.w||0)*60,cdE:(p.cd?.e||0)*60,cdR:(p.cd?.r||0)*60,potionCd:(p.cd?.space||0)*60,iframes:(p.inv||0)*60,spinTimer:(p.spin||0)*60,auraTimer:(p.aura||0)*60,flowTimer:(p.flow||0)*60,dashTimer:(p.dashLeft||0)*60,dashAngle:p.facing,blinkFlash:(p.blinkFlash||0)*60,attackAnim:(p.attackAnim||0)*60};}
function burstEvent(f){if(fxSeen.has(f.id))return;fxSeen.add(f.id);if(f.kind==='hit'){hitFlashes.set(f.target,frameCount+8);spawnBurst(f.x,f.y,f.color||'#ffeeaa',10,3);return;}if(f.kind==='death'){spawnBurst(f.x,f.y,'#c93c3c',24,4);return;}if(f.kind==='potion'){spawnBurst(f.x,f.y,'#ff4477',16,3);return;}if(f.kind==='burst'||f.kind==='blink'){const color=f.color||'#ff8a30',radius=f.r||40;spawnBurst(f.x,f.y,color,Math.floor(radius/2),radius*0.08);for(let r=20;r<radius;r+=14)spawnBurst(f.x,f.y,color,4,r*0.07);aoeRings.push({x:f.x,y:f.y,r:radius,life:24,maxLife:24,color});if(Math.hypot(f.x-player.x,f.y-player.y)<500)shake=Math.max(shake,Math.min(20,radius/6));}}
function tickParticles(){
for(const p of allPlayers){if(p.hp<=0)continue;
if(p.dashTimer>0){const t=(DASHCUT_DUR-p.dashTimer)/DASHCUT_DUR,perp=p.facing+Math.PI/2;for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const sign=i===0?1:-1,spin=frameCount*.9+i*Math.PI+t*6,r=10+Math.sin(spin)*6;spawnParticle(p.x+Math.cos(perp)*r*sign,p.y+Math.sin(perp)*r*sign,i===0?'#dde8ff':'#aaaaff',Math.cos(perp+Math.PI/2)*sign*.6,Math.sin(perp+Math.PI/2)*sign*.6,14,3);}spawnParticle(p.x,p.y,'#fff',0,0,10,5);if(frameCount%2===0){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,s=1.5+Math.random();spawnParticle(p.x,p.y,'#88ccff',Math.cos(a)*s,Math.sin(a)*s,18,2);}}
if(p.spinTimer>0&&frameCount%2===0){const a=frameCount*.6+Math.random()*.3;spawnParticle(p.x+Math.cos(a)*SPIN_RANGE*.9,p.y+Math.sin(a)*SPIN_RANGE*.9,'#ffdd44',0,0,14,3);}
if(p.flowTimer>0&&frameCount%2===0){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r=18+Math.random()*22;spawnParticle(p.x+Math.cos(a)*r,p.y+Math.sin(a)*r*.7,Math.random()<.6?'#5aaaff':'#aaddff',(Math.random()-.5)*.4,-.6-Math.random()*.6,28+Math.random()*10,3);}
}
for(const p of projectiles){if(p.kind==='slash'&&frameCount%2===0)spawnParticle(p.x+(Math.random()-.5)*20,p.y+(Math.random()-.5)*20,'#88ffee',0,0,14,3);else if(p.kind==='fireball'){spawnParticle(p.x+(Math.random()-.5)*8,p.y+(Math.random()-.5)*8,'#ff6020',0,0,14,4);if(frameCount%2===0)spawnParticle(p.x,p.y,'#ffcc40',0,0,10,3);}else if(p.kind==='mana_explosion'){for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r=Math.random()*14;spawnParticle(p.x+Math.cos(a)*r,p.y+Math.sin(a)*r,'#c060ff',0,0,18,3);}}else if(p.kind==='mana_ball'&&frameCount%2===0)spawnParticle(p.x,p.y,'#88ccff',0,0,10,2);}
for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vx*=.9;p.vy*=.9;p.life--;}particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0).slice(-2500);for(const r of aoeRings)r.life--;aoeRings=aoeRings.filter(r=>r.life>0);shake=Math.max(0,shake-1);flashRed=Math.max(0,flashRed-1);frameCount++;
}
return {draw(world,local,map,rooms,cam,input,dt){
CW=canvas.width;CH=canvas.height;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;ctx.fillStyle='#050403';ctx.fillRect(0,0,CW,CH);if(!local)return;
gameTime=world.time;tilemap=map;mapRooms=rooms;camera=cam;keeperDefeated=world.doorOpen;
allPlayers=world.players.map(p=>adaptPlayer(p.id===local.id?local:p));player=allPlayers.find(p=>p.id===local.id);
enemies=world.enemies.filter(e=>e.type!=='boss').map(e=>({...e,w:18,h:22,hitR:e.r,anim:frameCount*.1,hitFlash:Math.max(0,(hitFlashes.get(e.id)||0)-frameCount),elite:false,color:'#dcd4b0'}));enemyTotal=enemies.length;
const b=world.enemies.find(e=>e.type==='boss');boss=b?{...b,w:44,h:52,anim:frameCount*.1,phase:1,hitFlash:Math.max(0,(hitFlashes.get(b.id)||0)-frameCount)}:null;bossSpawned=!!boss&&Math.hypot(boss.x-player.x,boss.y-player.y)<650;
items=world.items.map(i=>({...i,bob:frameCount*.04,color:'#ff4477',w:26,h:30}));scenery=world.scenery||[];
projectiles=world.shots.map(s=>({...s,angle:Math.atan2(s.dy,s.dx),kind:s.kind==='mana'?'mana_explosion':s.kind==='bolt'?'mana_ball':s.kind,color:s.team?'#88aaff':'#ff8844'}));
aiming=input.aiming||null;moveTarget=input.move?{x:input.aimX,y:input.aimY}:null;
if(keeperDefeated)for(let x=48;x<52;x++)tilemap[54][x]=0;
currentRoomIdx=mapRooms.findIndex(r=>player.x>=r.x*T&&player.x<(r.x+r.w)*T&&player.y>=r.y*T&&player.y<(r.y+r.h)*T);if(currentRoomIdx>=0)visitedRooms.add(currentRoomIdx);
for(const p of allPlayers){if(hpSeen.has(p.id)&&p.hp<hpSeen.get(p.id)){spawnBurst(p.x,p.y,'#ff5555',12,3);if(p.id===local.id)flashRed=8;}hpSeen.set(p.id,p.hp);}
for(const f of world.fx)burstEvent(f);if(fxSeen.size>5000)fxSeen.clear();
particleAccumulator+=Math.min(dt,.1);while(particleAccumulator>=1/60){tickParticles();particleAccumulator-=1/60;}render();
ctx.font='bold 13px monospace';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillStyle=local.team==='red'?'#ff8888':'#88bbff';ctx.fillText(`${local.name} · ${local.team.toUpperCase()}`,24*uiScale(),128*uiScale());
ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='#d4b878';ctx.fillText(`RED ${world.scores.red}   |   BLUE ${world.scores.blue}`,CW/2,26*uiScale());
},reset(){visitedRooms.clear();particles=[];aoeRings=[];fxSeen.clear();hpSeen.clear();hitFlashes.clear();}};
}
